Some variable annuities allow you to choose optional insurance features called living benefits for an extra charge.
Long-term care insurance. This benefit pays for home health care or nursing home care if you become seriously ill.
answer: A variable annuity may offer long-term care insurance as an optional living benefit. If you become seriously ill, this benefit pays for home health care or nursing home care. Because it is optional, it may cost extra; review the contract to understand its terms and limitations.
